title: Serene Seasons X Distant Horizons - Backport
description: Backport of ItsThatNova's Serene Seasons and Distant Horizons compatibility mod for 1.20.1 Forge
body:
This is a port of ItsThatNova's 1.21.1 Fabric [Serene Seasons X Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-seasons-x-distant-horizons) compatibility mod to 1.20.1 Forge. 

It is not a one to one port as I did not port over the commands that Nova added. If you would like to see these commands or have a bug to report (as I haven't been able to do long term testing with the port to ensure it functions like the original, although I see no reason it shouldn't), feel free to let me know in my [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/g98QskMMpM).
